_provenance.notes: Sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria), also known as black cod, is Alaska's most valuable groundfish by ex-vessel value per pound. IFQ program implemented in 1995 — one of the most successful fisheries management programs in the world, eliminating the 'race to fish' and allowing fishermen to fish year-round safely.

NOAA AFSC. IFQ IMPLEMENTED — game changer. Season extends from weeks to 9 months. Safety dramatically improves.
